name: scripted_filesystem_project_workflow
description: Deterministic multi-turn session mimicking a real user building a small project: scaffold two files and list the dir (turn 1), actually run the program through the shell (turn 2), then read a file back to confirm (turn 3). Exercises write_file/list_dir/shell/read_file over the real sandbox end to end. Runs in CI.
input: Set up a small Python project: create app.py with a greet(name) function that returns a greeting and prints greet("Ada") when run, plus a README.md describing it. Then list the directory to confirm.

arguments.content:
# Demo App

`app.py` exposes `greet(name)` and prints a greeting for Ada when run.

scripted_responses.text: Created app.py (with greet) and README.md; the directory now lists both files.
Ran it: the program printed Hello, Ada!
Confirmed: app.py defines the greet function.

user_turns: Now run app.py and tell me what it prints.
Read app.py back and confirm the greet function is defined.
